subject: FinCloud KMS: escrow sampling & transit proof — scope and timeline
messages:
From: Alice Morgan <alice.morgan@fincloud.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: security@fincloud.com
Date: 2028-06-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: KMS/HSM artifacts — escrow sampling & transit proofs

Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for the quick demo last week. Our SOC2 team has one follow-up ask before we close out the onboarding workbook: can you provide a small sampling of artifacts that demonstrate your key custody and transit controls (we don't need full exports) — specifically:

- Operator access matrix for HSM/KMS admins (current assignments)
- A short slice of HSM access logs showing an operator key wrap/unwrap event (redacted PIIs are fine)
- Proof of transit encryption for wrapped key movement between sites (a sample SFTP transfer manifest or signed checksum)

Goal is to validate the end-to-end controls (ownership, rotation, transit). Can you confirm scope and a realistic delivery ETA?

If it helps, we can receive artifacts via SFTP.

Best,
Alice
Alice Morgan
Manager, Security Assurance — FinCloud
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Alice Morgan <alice.morgan@fincloud.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-01T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: KMS/HSM artifacts — escrow sampling & transit proofs

Alice — thanks for the note. We can provide a scoped sampling set that meets your SOC 2 team's need without exposing production secrets. Proposed deliverables and constraints below: 

Deliverables (sampling):
- Operator matrix (CSV): roles, current named operators, approval owner, last_access_review_date.
- Access log slice (TXT): 24-hour excerpt showing wrap/unwrap event lines, with request IDs — all crypto material redacted and replaced with deterministic placeholders.
- Transit manifest (JSONL sample as text): transfer record with checksum, transfer session id, and signed metadata.

Constraints/controls:
- We will never share plaintext private keys. Any key identifiers will be pseudonymized.
- For HSM logs we will redact operator IPs on request.
- Delivery will be via a one-time SFTP drop with time-bound credentials; we will also provide SHA256 checksums and a signed metadata file.

ETA: we can stage the sampling by EOD 2028-06-03 PT. Please confirm SFTP as acceptable and whether FinCloud needs a specific filename format or additional anonymization.

Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Alice Morgan <alice.morgan@fincloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-02T08:24:00-07:00
Subject: Re: KMS/HSM artifacts — escrow sampling & transit proofs

Adding a bit of detail on the operator matrix format so your SOC folks can parse quickly. We'll include: 

- operator_id, full_name, email, role (kms_admin | hsm_operator | auditor), assigned_scope (tenant_id), approval_owner, last_certification_date

I've attached a template CSV in the drop (kms-operator-matrix.csv). Also, for the HSM access slice we'll include the event types and request IDs in plain text but pseudonymize key labels (e.g., key-<4hex>).

Monica
Monica Patel
Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

[attachment: kms-operator-matrix.csv (text/csv)]
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Alice Morgan <alice.morgan@fincloud.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-03T14:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: KMS/HSM artifacts — escrow sampling & transit proofs

Alice — we staged the sampling on our SFTP and emailed one-time credentials to security@fincloud.com. Contents placed in /fincloud_dropoff/FC-4892/ with this manifest: 

- kms-operator-matrix.csv (CSV)
- hsm-access-sample-20280603.txt (redacted access logs)
- transit-manifest-20280603.txt (signed transfer metadata + SHA256 checksums)
- sftp-instructions.txt (one-time credentials and rotation window)

Attachment: sftp-instructions.txt (contains ephemeral SFTP user, expiry timestamp, and fingerprint).

Notes: 
- The transit manifest contains a signed entry showing wrap_id: wrap-7a2c and checksum sha256: <REDACTED-CHECKSUM> (we replaced long hex with placeholder in the copy inside the email; full checksum is in the manifest).
- If you require additional redaction (e.g., remove operator hostnames), tell us and we will re-run the slice; that will add ~1 business day.

Confirm when you have retrieved the files and we will schedule a short call if you want to walk through any lines.

Thanks,
Rishi
From: Alice Morgan <alice.morgan@fincloud.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: security@fincloud.com
Date: 2028-06-03T16:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: KMS/HSM artifacts — escrow sampling & transit proofs

Rishi / team — received the SFTP creds and downloaded the manifest and samples. Quick confirmation: the sampling looks good to our SOC 2 reviewer, and the transit manifest includes the signed metadata we requested. We may circle back with a few clarifying questions on the log timestamps, but no major asks right now.

We appreciate the timed delivery and the SFTP pattern — that matches our intake process. Marking this item as 'satisfied' pending two minor clarifications we will file in HubSpot.

Best,
Alice
